integrationEvidence.note: CONTENT_SPRITESHEET_BASES is derived from biomeFish assetKey values.
Runtime loads /assets/generated/<assetKey>.frames.json and then the packed PNG as a spritesheet.
Biome fish entries are instantiated during world generation from biomeFish[state.biome].
drawFish advances frames with animatedFrame and fishFrameCount.
If a sprite manifest is present, drawFish uses the packed spritesheet frame; otherwise it falls back to loose <assetKey>-<frame> texture.
Articulated manifest and part textures load from /assets/generated/articulated-creatures.parts.json.
Prototype articulated creatures spawn only when prototype runtime query flags are enabled.
Eligible articulated manifests are spawned by biome and spawn budget.
